description.p: This page documents the visible properties returned by properties for a wordcloud graphics object.

tr.td: updates the annotation metadata used by interactive tools and object inspection.
Type: graphics annotation object or empty handle value. Supported values: an annotation object associated with the graphics item, or an empty graphics handle when no annotation is attached.
Nelson computes this value; graphics operations update it.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
controls whether the chart frame is displayed.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
controls whether an interrupting callback is queued or canceled.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'queue', 'cancel'.
runs when the object receives a mouse-button event.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
parenting operations update the vector.
Type: graphics object handle vector. Supported values: empty vector.
sets the default color used for rendered words.
Type: color value or color matrix. Supported values: short color names, RGB triplet with values in [0,1], hexadecimal color, or an n-by-3 color matrix.
attaches the menu used for context-click actions.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: [] or a uicontextmenu handle.
runs when the object is created.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
runs when the object is deleted.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
updates the label used by legend entries and object identification.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
sets the font family used to render words.
Type: text value. Supported values: installed font family name as a character row vector or string scalar.
controls whether handle-search functions can find the object.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off', 'callback'.
sets the color used by highlighted words.
Type: color value. Supported values: short color names, RGB triplet with values in [0,1], or hexadecimal color.
includes or excludes the object from mouse hit testing.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
controls whether a running callback can be interrupted.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
stores the inner chart rectangle.
Type: numeric row vector. Supported values: four finite values [left bottom width height].
stores tiled layout placement information.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: [] or a layout options handle.
selects the deterministic layout variant.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: positive integer values.
sets the maximum number of displayed words.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: nonnegative integer values.
sets the parent graphics container used by the object.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: figure handle.
controls whether visible or all object parts can be picked.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'visible', 'all', 'none'.
stores the outer chart rectangle.
Type: numeric row vector. Supported values: four finite values [left bottom width height].
stores the chart position rectangle.
Type: numeric row vector. Supported values: four finite values [left bottom width height].
selects which position rectangle is preserved during layout.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'outerposition', 'innerposition'.
marks the object as selected or not selected.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
controls display of selection handles.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
sets the layout envelope for word placement.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'oval', 'rectangle'.
sets the numeric weights used to size words.
Type: real numeric vector. Supported values: finite numeric values.
stores the table variable used for word sizes.
Type: text value. Supported values: [] or a variable name from the source table.
sets the exponent used when mapping word weights to font sizes.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: positive numeric scalar values.
stores the table used to create the chart.
Type: table or empty value. Supported values: [] or a table supplied to wordcloud.
stores user-defined text for identifying the object.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
sets the chart title text.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
sets the font family used to render the chart title.
Type: text value. Supported values: installed font family name as a character row vector or string scalar.
identifies the graphics object type.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'wordcloud'.
sets units used by position properties.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'normalized', 'pixels', 'inches', 'centimeters', 'points', 'characters'.
stores user-defined data on the object.
Type: any Nelson value. Supported values: any value.
shows or hides the object.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
sets the words displayed by the chart.
Type: string vector or cell vector of character rows. Supported values: nonempty text values.
stores the table variable used for displayed words.
Type: text value. Supported values: [] or a variable name from the source table.
